name: Elemental Healing (Metamagic, Mythic)
body:
The goodness in your element lingers and pervades everything.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Healing.

Benefits: You may choose to treat neutral targets either as good or evil when casting a spell modified with Elemental Healing. For creatures it damages, the spell is treated as a persistent spell. Creatures that are cured by the spell are granted any excess hit points as temporary hit points that last until they are lost.
